notes.title: One month later
notes.content:
It's been about a month since Virtual Idea Area has been released and the response has generally been positive. Thanks everyone! ːsteamhappyː

Since then I've been doing a lot of under-the-hood changes to prepare for new features and to keep the program code from becoming a big mess. I've had a bunch of great feature suggestions from the community which has helped me decide what to add next. The first big update is still a few weeks out (or maybe even months, depending on circumstances) but here's a little peek at one of the new features:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28306477/4f82ffa17caf68f66e97ef6167b48eb0c34d8291.png[/img]

notes.title: Released!
notes.content:
Virtual Idea Area is now available to everyone and to celebrate it is 10% off during the first week.
Enjoy unlimited whiteboards in virtual reality! I'm looking forward to seeing what people will use them for!
